topic: ISO 9000, Benefits of ISO 9000, ISO 9000 series of standards – ISO 9000: 2008, 9001: 2008, 9004: 2008, Registration process
syllabus_extract: ISO 9000, Benefits of ISO 9000, ISO 9000 series of standards – ISO 9000: 2008, 9001: 2008, 9004: 2008, Registration process
specific_objectives: 30.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the concept of quality assurance, control and indigenization.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of ISO 9001:2008 clauses; Safety: None; Supervision: Instructor monitors PPT navigation
intro_questions: What is the primary goal of Quality Assurance?
Define Quality Control in an engineering context.
Why is indigenization important for national defense?

development.content:
Concept of Quality Assurance
Quality Control vs Quality Assurance
Role of Indigenization in QA
Benefits of ISO 9000 Implementation
Overview of ISO 9000 Series

ISO 9000:2008 Scope and Purpose
ISO 9001:2008 Requirements for Certification
ISO 9004:2008 Guidelines for Performance
Key Differences Between 9000, 9001, 9004
Importance of Documentation in Standards

Steps in the Registration Process
Role of Certification Bodies
Audit Types: Initial and Surveillance
Maintaining Certification Compliance
Consequences of Non-Conformance

summary_questions: Explain the difference between ISO 9001 and ISO 9004.
List three benefits of implementing ISO 9000 standards.
Describe the first step in the ISO registration process.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the role of NAQAS and RAQAS in aeronautical quality assurance certification to be discussed in LP 05.

pft_rows.syllabus: Role of regulatory bodies such as NAQAS, RAQAS, DGAQA and CEMILAC in certification of aeronautical quality assurance. BIS, Organisational activities of BIS, BIS certification scheme. Brief explanation of various quality checked symbols issued by Govt. of India on various fields
